integrity: Mathematical result supported by a written analytic proof and 2015 finite standalone diagnostics. The computations do not establish any infinite-parameter conclusion; priority and generalization are not independently certified.
limitations: Stationary athermal, linearly harmonically confined inertial dynamics; no additive thermal noise or nonlinear trap.
Only position autocovariance sign and first negative lag are classified; not sample-path oscillations or spectral-peak optimization.
Finite observation horizons may not show a negative lag arbitrarily close to the threshold.
No independent audit or independent validation has been performed; broader classical filtering literature may contain an implicit equivalent statement.
title: A sharp autocorrelation sign boundary for an inertial run-and-tumble oscillator
